decision_rules.protocol: dc_joint fitted on E0+E1+E2 matches strictly before each date on which an E0 or E1 match is predicted (3-year lookback). Variant (plain, or move shift with d_down = 0) and xi in {0.001, 0.0019, 0.003, 0.005, 0.007, 0.01} chosen by the mean of E0 and E1 validation RPS (2015/16-2017/18), equal weight per league; ties: plain, then smaller xi; a grid-edge optimum is a limitation, the grid is not extended. Baseline dc_v1 at its own xi (E0 0.003, E1 0.005) must first reproduce E0 RPS 0.2016 on 3,090 matches and the championship experiment's E1 RPS on 4,511, else stop. Test 2018/19 to 2026-09-20. CIs: paired date-block bootstrap, 5,000 resamples; 95% decides, 98.3% (Bonferroni, 3 questions) is a robustness line.
decision_rules.Q1: E0 test: per-match RPS(dc_joint) - RPS(dc_v1). Improvement if the 95% CI is entirely below 0.
decision_rules.Q3: Pre-registered subgroup: matches involving a team in its first 10 games after entering E0 or E1, both leagues pooled (dates resampled jointly). Same rule. Per league and per direction of entry reported, not decisive.
decision_rules.interpretation: Unconstrained up/down shifts and cross-league gaps are not interpreted (not identified, or only weakly).

fitted_at_test_end.note: b and shifts are identified only through movers; not interpreted as league gaps
